sections.passage: Process records reveal choices and experiments that finished work may hide. Record unsuccessful changes honestly as well as successful ones.

sections.title: Human Sciences — Comparing explanations
sections.passage: Different explanations may fit one observation. Compare their evidence, assumptions, and limits. Confidence or elaborate detail does not automatically establish reliability.

sections.title: Computer Science — Project plans and versions
sections.passage: Plans specify requirements, steps, and completion checks. Versioned copies support recovery and comparison. Small tested changes are easier to understand than many untested changes.

items.prompt: Why save versions?

sections.title: Life Skills — Planning steps and supplies
sections.passage: Project plans include requirements, materials, time, sequence, and completion checks. Dependencies mean some steps need others first. Include alternatives when supplies change.

sections.title: Art — Refine and explain
sections.passage: Refinement uses feedback and evaluation. Artist statements explain choices without requiring every viewer to feel the same. Support claims with observable features.

sections.title: Human Sciences — Reasoned reflection
sections.passage: Reflection explains how evidence and reasons shape conclusions. Students can evaluate reasoning without announcing religious identities or changing beliefs. Honest reflection can include uncertainty.

Show one piece of this week's work and explain one correction or improvement.

sections.title: Computer Science — Documentation
sections.passage: Documentation explains a project's purpose, inputs, outputs, operation, and limits. Write for a person who did not build it. Test whether the guide works without extra coaching.

items.prompt: Who needs documentation?
Show one piece of this week's work and explain one correction or improvement.

sections.title: Life Skills — Independent task demonstration
sections.passage: Responsible independence includes completing suitable tasks and recognizing when help is needed. Check results against agreed standards and explain limitations honestly.

items.prompt: Does independence mean never asking for help?
